}}'''Chapter 333''' is titled "Captain".

==Cover Page==
[[Gedatsu's Accidental Blue-Sea Life]], Vol. 18: "The Boom's Brought Out the Forest Boss".

As the hot-spring keeps gushing, [[Goro]] and [[Gedatsu]] are confronted by the island's [[Forest Boss]]—a huge baboon.

==Short Summary==
The duel between [[Usopp]] and [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] continues with a victor finally emerging in the end.

==Long Summary==
The [[Straw Hat Pirates]] look on as [[Usopp]] and [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] continue their duel in the smoke covered area. The pair attack at the same time, but Usopp reverses Luffy's attack with an [[Dials#Impact_Dial|Impact Dial]]. An exhausted Usopp is shocked to see that Luffy is still standing and the pair stare at each other while remembering making the Straw Hat Pirates' [[Jolly Roger|flag]]. Luffy finally hits Usopp with a final attack causing him to collapse to the ground completely defeated.

As the others watch in pain, Luffy walks towards the ship telling a defeated Usopp that the [[Going Merry]] is his as they will get a new ship. He bids farewell to him while remembering the good times that they have had together. [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]], devastated by the events, attempts to check Usopp's wounds but he is stopped by [[Sanji]] who explains how painful it must feel for already being pitied.

As they leave the ship, all except for [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] and Sanji are in tears as they say goodbye to both Usopp and Going Merry.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Usopp]] is defeated.
**Luffy gives Usopp the [[Going Merry]], even though he won the duel, saying they will get a new ship and sail onto the seas ahead.
*[[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] tries to treat Usopp's wounds, but [[Sanji]] stops him, explaining that being pitied after losing a fight is painful.
**The [[Straw Hat Pirates]] prepare to clear the ship, with everyone except [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] and Sanji in tears, saying they cannot return to the Going Merry ever again.
